description: This file defines the 'Holiday' entity class for the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes properties for holiday attributes (such as id, name, date, length, recurring, operational country) and defines constants related to holiday durations. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: Holiday
classes.description: Entity class representing a holiday in the system, including attributes like date, name, duration, and associated operational country.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the holiday.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the holiday.

methods.name: isRecurring
methods.description: Checks if the holiday recurs annually.

methods.name: setRecurring
methods.description: Sets the recurring flag for the holiday.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the description/name of the holiday.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the description/name of the holiday.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the holiday.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the holiday.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length/duration of the holiday.

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets the length/duration of the holiday.

methods.name: getOperationalCountry
methods.description: Returns the operational country associated with the holiday.

methods.name: setOperationalCountry
methods.description: Sets the operational country associated with the holiday.
